# Best AI Agent Tool Libraries & Integration PlatformsCompanies

## What is AI Agent Tool Libraries & Integration Platforms?

The AI agent tool libraries & integration platforms market provides developers with pre-built connectors, APIs, and SDKs to enable AI agents to interact with external applications and services. These platforms offer tool-calling capabilities, authentication management, and orchestration frameworks that allow AI agents to access hundreds of third-party tools through unified interfaces. Companies in this market typically provide features such as OAuth handling, function calling support for multiple LLM frameworks, workflow automation capabilities, and monitoring tools. The solutions enable developers to quickly build production-ready AI agents that can perform actions across various SaaS applications, databases, and APIs without building individual integrations from scratch.
